page.overview:
Who is Mason Blair?

Mason Blair is a major characters in To Be Beautiful, a second story of Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit. He is Sarah's love interest who she initially embarrasses herself in front of, then later dates.

Mason is tall with dark-lashed, ocean-blue eyes. He also has straight and white teeth.

Mason is said to be nice and funny. He is also rather laid-back, never raising his voice when annoyed and later finding his minor grievances funny.

One day, Sarah accidently bumps into Mason at school as she's trying to desperately leave the cafeteria, dumping the remains of her salad on his expensive, crisp white designer shirt. He looks annoyed tells Sarah to watch where she's going as he picks a cucumber slice off his shirt, leaving a perfect oily circle in the middle of his chest. Sarah apologies and throws the rest of her food away, running out the cafeteria.
